{- outer {- nested -} still a comment -}
let Person = { name : Text, age : Natural }

let greet = \(p : Person) -> "Hello, ${p.name}!"

let people =
      [ { name = "Ann", age = 30 }, { name = "Bob", age = 25 } ] : List Person

let multi =
      ''
      Multi-line ${Natural/show 42}
      ''

in  { greetings = List/map Person Text greet people
    , adults = Natural/isZero 0 && True
    , missingValue = None Natural
    , ratio = 1.5
    , multi
    }
